tool_args.rationale: The five paid observations all use H = 3.6 and show a strongly damped response approximately proportional to u_now. A horizon-discriminating measurement is needed to separate plausible temporal mechanisms before fitting and confirming a predictive law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations have the same horizon, so its horizon-dependent parameters are not separately identifiable.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a damped fast-transient or adiabatic relaxation model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot signatures and near-proportionality to u_now are compatible with this family, but the existing rows do not distinguish its horizon dependence from alternatives.
It is cheaper, but the fixed-horizon observations leave horizon dependence as the primary ambiguity.
It is not relevant to identifying the temporal law.
